title: A claude-settings check proves every module a raw-fetched shared script imports is in the child repos' documented fetch list
why: Sighting (coordinator 08:01 CST Nov 14, from runner 11; cause read from runner 11's message and log line, not read by the coordinator in the run; triage read nothing): child repos fetch check_shared_resources.py, layout.py and layout.json as raw URLs at a pin. layout.py at stable (fccff95) imports git_reads, which that fetch list lacks, so degen #704 went red on its first ready run (run 43602367466, step "shared resources": ModuleNotFoundError git_reads). Mistake: a change to a fetched script's imports shipped with no check that the child fetch lists cover them. Guard that would have stopped it: a claude-settings check that every module a raw-fetched script imports is in the documented fetch list. Red first: add an import of a module outside the list to one fetched script and the check fails; remove it and it passes. Scan the imports with Python's own parser (ast), not by matching strings. A check change in claude-settings, so round 3 applies. The coordinator's pick on #704: option A, revert the three pins to 635b37b (labelled the coordinator's own).
note: Filed 08:03 CST Nov 14 by triage. Tracker: the coordinator. No lane yet. The guard the coordinator named: slug child-fetch-list-covers-imports.
